articles.title: Churu Youth Rides Bike Into Hospital Ward, Saves Elderly Train Passenger
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Churu – In a remarkable act of humanity, a 28-year-old man rushed a critically ill passenger straight into the emergency ward of DB Hospital on his motorbike, saving the elderly man’s life.

body.html:
Churu – In a remarkable act of humanity, a 28-year-old man rushed a critically ill passenger straight into the emergency ward of DB Hospital on his motorbike, saving the elderly man’s life.

The patient, 65-year-old Bhalleram of Fatehabad, Haryana, was travelling with his family from Bikaner to Delhi after visiting Baba Ramdev when he suddenly collapsed inside the train near Churu. A diabetic, his blood sugar levels had dropped, leaving him unconscious and unresponsive.

Panicked, his son Ran Singh pulled the chain to stop the train. At that moment, Shubham Devda, who had come to drop his friend at the station, noticed the commotion. Without hesitation, he seated Bhalleram on his bike and drove directly into the hospital’s emergency ward—much like a scene from the film Three Idiots.

Doctors and nurses quickly shifted the patient to a bed and began treatment. Tests confirmed a severe drop in blood sugar as the cause of his collapse. Thanks to the swift response, Bhalleram’s condition stabilized.

Medical College Principal Dr. MM Pukar praised Shubham’s selfless act, calling it “an inspiring example of humanity.” He appealed to the public to extend similar help in emergencies, stressing that timely assistance can save lives.

#Churu #HumanityFirst #LifeSaved #ViralStory #RajasthanNews #InspiringAct #GoodSamaritan

articles.title: 13 Masked Goons Storm Hospital, Attack Doctor
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: #InShort | 13 masked men stormed Sanjeevani Hospital, brutally assaulting Dr. Mandeep Madia & staff with sticks, bottles & sharp weapons. CCTV captured the violent attack, sparking panic. Police booked 5 named & 8 unknown accused; probe underway.

body.html:
#InShort | 13 masked men stormed Sanjeevani Hospital, brutally assaulting Dr. Mandeep Madia & staff with sticks, bottles & sharp weapons. CCTV captured the violent attack, sparking panic. Police booked 5 named & 8 unknown accused; probe underway.

* * *

Jhansi (Uttar Pradesh) – A violent attack took place at Sanjeevani Hospital, where 13 masked men stormed the premises and brutally assaulted a doctor and staff. The entire incident, including slaps and punches on the doctor, has been captured on CCTV and has since gone viral.

According to police, the attack occurred around 3:30 pm on Monday after a patient, Kamlesh Devi, was discharged a day earlier. Her son, Shivdeep, along with friends carrying hockey sticks and batons, entered the hospital and began vandalising property. They then barged into the chamber of Dr. Mandeep Madia and attacked him with sharp weapons and bottles. During the assault, a staff member sustained a hand injury, while two women employees, Renu and Ramvati, were also hurt.

Dr. Mandeep, a resident of Ganesh Enclave, said the masked assailants came prepared, knowing CCTV cameras were installed, and deliberately covered their faces. Panic gripped the hospital as patients and staff ran for safety.

On Dr. Mandeep’s complaint, police have registered a case at Navabad police station against named accused – Shivdeep, Hrithik, Deepak, Mayank, Jayant – along with eight unidentified attackers, on charges of vandalism and murderous assault. Inspector Santosh Awasthi said identification of the attackers is underway using CCTV footage, and a search has been launched.

The brazen attack has raised questions on hospital security and safety of doctors, as Dr. Mandeep remarked, “How can I treat patients when I am not safe myself?”

articles.title: Gujarat Police Under Fire: Murder Accused Seen ‘Taught to Limp’ in Viral Video
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Anand (Gujarat) – A viral video from Anand district has sparked outrage after it showed the accused in the Nawakhal village murder case allegedly being instructed by police to fake a limp while coming out of lockup.

body.html:
Anand (Gujarat) – A viral video from Anand district has sparked outrage after it showed the accused in the Nawakhal village murder case allegedly being instructed by police to fake a limp while coming out of lockup.

The accused, Ajay, is facing charges in the brutal murder of an innocent girl. In the video, he is first seen walking normally. Moments later, a PSI approaches and whispers something in his ear. Immediately after, Ajay begins limping as he exits the lockup.

The clip has raised serious questions about police conduct, with many accusing the force of stage-managing the accused’s condition. Locals and netizens have expressed anger, calling it a “performance” instead of professional policing.

Authorities are yet to issue an official clarification, but pressure is mounting over the integrity of the investigation.

articles.title: Madhya Pradesh Shockers: Cops Suspended After Obscene Dance Videos Go Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Bhopal – Two policemen posted at Civil Lines Police Station in Datia have been suspended after a video surfaced showing Assistant Sub-Inspector (ASI) Sanjeev Gaud dancing in an “objectionable” manner with women dancers at a private party.

body.html:
Bhopal – Two policemen posted at Civil Lines Police Station in Datia have been suspended after a video surfaced showing Assistant Sub-Inspector (ASI) Sanjeev Gaud dancing in an “objectionable” manner with women dancers at a private party. The party, held on 2 September at a hotel to celebrate Constable Rahul Boudh’s birthday, featured professional dancers.

The viral clip shows the ASI making obscene gestures while dancing to Bollywood songs. Both Gaud and Boudh have been suspended, with Datia SP Suraj Verma ordering a departmental inquiry.

The incidents have drawn sharp criticism, raising questions about police conduct and discipline. Senior officials have indicated stricter action may follow.

articles.title: Palwal Man Alleges Wife Hid Marriage to Secure Delhi Police Job – Case Echoes Jyoti Maurya Row
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Palwal (Haryana) – A controversial case of alleged betrayal has surfaced in Palwal, drawing parallels to the much-talked-about Jyoti Maurya–Alok Maurya dispute in Uttar Pradesh.

body.html:
Palwal (Haryana) – A controversial case of alleged betrayal has surfaced in Palwal, drawing parallels to the much-talked-about Jyoti Maurya–Alok Maurya dispute in Uttar Pradesh.

Pitam (26), a resident of Barauli village, claims his wife concealed her marital status to obtain a Delhi Police job. According to Pitam, he met the woman in 2021 at his library in Rajiv Nagar, where he trained youth for government exams. Their relationship grew, and they married on 4 January 2023 at Arya Samaj Mandir, Ballabhgarh.

After marriage, the couple shifted to a rented flat. Pitam says he sold his library and part of his land to fund his wife’s studies and preparation, assisting her through both written and physical exams. During verification, he alleges, she declared herself unmarried.

The woman was selected for Delhi Police training in February 2024. After completing training in February 2025, she allegedly returned to her parental home and refused to live with Pitam.

Pitam has filed complaints with the Haryana Chief Minister, Delhi Police Commissioner, and the National Human Rights Commission, alleging fraud and threats. He has also moved court under Section 9 (Restitution of Conjugal Rights), with the next hearing scheduled for February 2026.

This case once again raises questions over deception in relationships and misuse of official recruitment processes.

articles.title: Home Guard Torches Liquor Shop After Being Denied alcohol on credit
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: #InShort | A Dial-112 Home Guard allegedly torched a liquor shop in Daurala after being refused alcohol on credit. CCTV shows him pouring petrol & setting it ablaze before fleeing. Locals doused the fire. He’s now in custody.

body.html:
#InShort | A Dial-112 Home Guard allegedly torched a liquor shop in Daurala after being refused alcohol on credit. CCTV shows him pouring petrol & setting it ablaze before fleeing. Locals doused the fire. He’s now in custody.

* * *

Meerut (Uttar Pradesh) – A Home Guard posted on Dial-112 duty allegedly set fire to a liquor shop in Daurala after being denied alcohol on credit. The incident took place late Saturday night and has been captured on CCTV.

The footage shows a man in khaki trousers, a black vest, and a towel around his head, walking barefoot near the shop. He is seen pouring petrol from a bottle outside the premises, striking a match, and igniting the fire before fleeing on his bike. A passerby on a bicycle is also visible in the clip.

Police said the accused, identified as Kapil, first approached the shop requesting alcohol on credit. When refused, he left but returned later to torch the outlet. Locals quickly responded to reports of the blaze and brought the fire under control.

A case has been registered on the salesman’s complaint. Kapil has been taken into custody and, during interrogation, admitted frustration over being refused alcohol.

articles.title: DM Orders Probe as Family Forced to Carry Body on Bike in Kaushambi
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kaushambi district has witnessed a disturbing incident that has sparked outrage across Uttar Pradesh. A video going viral on social media shows a helpless family transporting the body of a deceased relative on a motorcycle for nearly 30 km after failing to get an ambulance from the...

body.html:
Kaushambi district has witnessed a disturbing incident that has sparked outrage across Uttar Pradesh. A video going viral on social media shows a helpless family transporting the body of a deceased relative on a motorcycle for nearly 30 km after failing to get an ambulance from the government hospital.

The family claimed they repeatedly sought an ambulance but received no assistance, leaving them with no option but to tie the body to a bike and take it home.

Taking note of the viral video, the District Magistrate of Kaushambi has ordered a probe. A joint team from the district administration, health department, and police has been assigned to investigate the lapse.
